## Pre-Merge Checklist

<!-- Check all items before requesting review -->

### Code Quality

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
- [ ] TypeScript type check passes (`pnpm run type-check`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`pnpm run lint`)

### Testing

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`pnpm run test`)
- [ ] I have tested the changes in a local development environment
- [ ] I have tested edge cases and error scenarios

### Database

- [ ] Database schema changes are included (if applicable)
- [ ] Migration scripts are tested and reversible (if applicable)
- [ ] Database changes are backward compatible (if applicable)

### Documentation

- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (README, deployment docs, etc.)
- [ ] I have added/updated inline code comments where necessary
- [ ] API changes are documented (if applicable)
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented (if applicable)

### Security

- [ ] I have reviewed my changes for security vulnerabilities
- [ ] No sensitive data (passwords, API keys, tokens) is committed
- [ ] Input validation is implemented for user-facing features
- [ ] Authentication/authorization is properly implemented (if applicable)

### Deployment

- [ ] This PR is safe to deploy to production
- [ ] No manual deployment steps are required
- [ ] Environment variables are documented (if new ones added)
- [ ] Rollback plan is considered (if high-risk change)
